name: dbstudio-desktop
description: Rowlit: see your data in a better light. A fast desktop client for SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB and Kafka
author: Rowlit contributors

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/engine-process.test.mjs test/ipc-validate.test.mjs test/platform.test.mjs test/updater.test.mjs test/windows.test.mjs test/data-dir.test.mjs test/smoke.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test test/engine-process.test.mjs test/ipc-validate.test.mjs test/platform.test.mjs test/updater.test.mjs test/windows.test.mjs test/data-dir.test.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=-
scripts.dist:mac:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never -c.mac.identity=-
